name: Tiger 5
subtitle: Wing double screen away
goal: Sell 4 as the first option, then spring 3 off two screens for a layup.
options: Best: 3 catching at the free throw line and finishing at speed. 4 in the short corner is the decoy.

steps.note: 4 fakes a screen for 2 and slips to the short corner, calling for the ball. It is not a real screen: 4 is the decoy. At the same time, 1 and 5 set staggered screens for 3 along the foul line extended.
3 curls over the top of both screens, out past the three-point line, then turns straight down the lane. 2 hits 3 at the free throw line.
3 keeps going straight down the lane at full speed for the layup.
